documents.text: For SipTrue, DNS is managed in Wix. Mike adds the CNAME records in Wix under Manage DNS Records.
The SipTrue application and widget are deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
Google Search Console data is already ingested into Snowflake. Do not try Google Workspace for GSC analysis.
Use the Looker REST API for source-faithful dashboard and explore inspection.
Correction: the support variable is VITE_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_EMAIL, not VITE_SUPPORT_EMAIL.
Correction: Supabase custom domains require the Pro plan plus the Custom Domain add-on.
The launch owner is Priya and the rollback window is Friday.
The approved release color is amber, not green.
Sibling agents in one workgroup share the same thread worktrees while keeping separate provider state.
There is exactly one writable Markdown memory canon for each workgroup.
When a dedicated MCP is absent, try the real HTTPS API through the OneCLI gateway before claiming no access.
Snowflake ordinal gaps require explicit column ordering during additive schema changes.
Fivetran connector state is available from the REST API through the Madison Reed credential scope.
Hex Context Studio suggestions are inspected with hex suggestion list.
Sunday dinner was tomato soup and grilled cheese.
The morning running route loops around the lake.
